answer: Summit Auto Lease, Crescent Motor Credit and Apex Lease Co pass lease equity (the amount by which our offer exceeds the lease buyout) to the customer. Bluewater Leasing applies the equity to a car the customer buys from Northwind, and Harbor Leasing and Ironwood Lease don't allow third-party buyouts at all. Crescent Motor Credit has allowed third-party buyouts since February 1, 2026. Since that same date, Apex Lease Co adds a $350 third-party buyout fee to the buyout amount, which raises the buyout and so lowers the customer's equity.
